text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it reaffirmed the D One Plus commercial paper rating of Jefferson-Pilot Corp.
It also placed the AAA claims-paying ability of Jefferson-Pilot Life Insurance Co, Alexander Hamilton Life Insurance Co and First Alexander Hamilton Life Insurance Co on watch - developing.

The rating actions were implemented following Jefferson-Pilot's announcement that it intends to buy Chubb Corp's Chubb Life Insurance Co of America. Final ratings determinations are pending a due diligence review of the proposed integrated operations of Jefferson-Pilot Corp's existing insurance units and Chubb Life Insurance. ((-- Chicago newsdesk 312 408-8787))
